name: glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass panels with backdrop blur over vivid backgrounds
best_for: SaaS dashboards, fintech apps, marketing hero sections
anti_patterns: Low contrast text on transparent panels; overuse on every surface

name: claymorphism
description: Soft, puffy 3D shapes with inset/outset shadows resembling clay
best_for: Kids apps, playful consumer apps, onboarding flows
anti_patterns: Heavy shadows hurting performance; unreadable on dark backgrounds

name: neumorphism
description: Extruded, monochrome surfaces using subtle dual shadows
best_for: Settings panels, music players, single-tone dashboards
anti_patterns: Fails accessibility contrast; unusable for primary CTAs

name: minimalism
description: Generous whitespace, restrained palette, single accent color
anti_patterns: Empty feeling if used for data-dense dashboards

name: brutalism
description: Raw, unpolished layouts with stark typography and visible structure
best_for: Design studios, art portfolios, indie brands
anti_patterns: Hurts usability for transactional/enterprise apps

name: neubrutalism
description: Bold flat colors with thick black outlines and offset hard shadows
best_for: Startup landing pages, dev tools, youth brands
effects: thick 2-4px borders;offset box-shadow no blur;bold flat colors
anti_patterns: Overuse of clashing colors reduces readability

name: flat-design
description: Simple 2D shapes, no gradients/shadows, bold solid colors
best_for: Mobile apps, icon systems, marketing sites
anti_patterns: Lacks depth cues for complex interactive hierarchies

name: material-design
description: Google's elevation-based system with ripple feedback and grid
best_for: Android apps, productivity tools, cross-platform apps
anti_patterns: Feels dated if not paired with current type scale

name: skeuomorphism
description: Mimics real-world textures and objects (leather, paper, metal)
best_for: Music/audio apps, camera apps, niche nostalgia products
anti_patterns: Heavy, dated look; poor scalability across screen sizes

name: bento-grid
description: Modular grid of rounded boxes of varying sizes, Apple-style
anti_patterns: Cramped content when boxes are too small for their text

name: dark-mode
description: Dark background UI with light text and muted accent surfaces

anti_patterns: Pure black backgrounds cause halation; low-contrast grays

name: high-contrast-dark

name: swiss-design
